# Everyone the release alert must reach.
#
# One GitHub handle per line. `#` starts a comment (inline is fine); blank
# lines are ignored. Parsed by .github/scripts/release_roster.sh, which is the
# ONLY thing that should read this file.
#
# Two consumers:
#   • .github/scripts/release_alert_body.sh — builds the @mention line
#   • .github/workflows/release-ack.yaml    — the denominator for the ack tally
#
# This is a HAND-CURATED list, NOT a mirror of any GitHub team. It was the
# Disasters-Learning-Portal/disasters team until 2026-08-25 and is now chosen by
# hand, so do not "resync" it from the team API — several people here are not on
# that team, and several team members are deliberately not here.
#
# It is also not read from the org API at run time: the default GITHUB_TOKEN is
# repo-scoped and 403s on /orgs/{org}/teams/{slug}/members, so reading it live
# would mean granting a PAT `Organization permissions -> Members: Read` and
# inheriting that PAT's expiry as a new silent failure mode.
#
# ADDING SOMEONE: put the handle here with their name in a trailing comment, and
# say HOW you identified them. The names matter — most of these accounts have no
# display name, no bio and no public commits, so a bare handle is genuinely hard
# to re-identify later, and a plausible-looking guess is how the wrong person
# ends up on a distribution list. Markers used below:
#   [profile] GitHub display name    [email] commit-author email
#   [handle]  handle spells the name  [confirmed] identified by a maintainer
#
# A MISTYPED HANDLE MENTIONS NOBODY AND FAILS SILENTLY. That is not theoretical:
# the v1.0.1 alert (#120) used a team mention, notified no one, and nothing
# surfaced it. `release-ack.yaml` now validates every handle here against the
# GitHub API before it renders, so a typo fails the run instead of the release.
#
# Matching is case-insensitive, so casing here is cosmetic.
#
# Last curated: 2026-08-25

jrbell1              # JR Bell          [handle]
alex-melancon        # Alex Melancon    [handle]
taylordupre          # Taylor DuPre     [profile]
kyle-lesinger        # Kyle Lesinger    [profile]
chelsea-aaron        # Chelsea Aaron    [email] chelsea.aaron@uah.edu
